definitions.top1_accuracy: argmax of the K class outputs == native label mapped to the run's vocabulary
definitions.mean_p_qcd: softmax mass on the vocabulary's QCD classes, averaged over resonant / QCD jets
definitions.ens: softmax averaged over the epoch checkpoints, then scored
definitions.wavg: weights (and BatchNorm buffers) averaged over the epoch checkpoints
definitions.stream_qcd_share: QCD classes' share of weaver's per-epoch 'Train class distribution' in train.log
definitions.swing_test: spread of the epoch values against a paired bootstrap: each replicate resamples the jets once and scores every epoch on them (all 500,000 jets for the head; the probe's test split, fits held fixed, for log(1-AUC)); chi2 of the deviations from the epoch mean with their bootstrap covariance, K-1 dof

rules.top1_10pct_vs_median: top-1 accuracy more than 10% below the median of the run's epochs 70-79
rules.top1_10pct_vs_q75: top-1 accuracy more than 10% below the 75th percentile of the run's epochs 70-79
rules.top1_10pct_vs_most_accurate_epoch: top-1 accuracy more than 10% below its value at the most accurate of the run's epochs 70-79
rules.top1_5pct_vs_median: top-1 accuracy more than 5% below the median of the run's epochs 70-79
rules.top1_5pct_vs_q75: top-1 accuracy more than 5% below the 75th percentile of the run's epochs 70-79
rules.top1_5pct_vs_most_accurate_epoch: top-1 accuracy more than 5% below its value at the most accurate of the run's epochs 70-79
rules.top1_15pct_vs_median: top-1 accuracy more than 15% below the median of the run's epochs 70-79
rules.top1_15pct_vs_q75: top-1 accuracy more than 15% below the 75th percentile of the run's epochs 70-79
rules.top1_15pct_vs_most_accurate_epoch: top-1 accuracy more than 15% below its value at the most accurate of the run's epochs 70-79
rules.qcd_log_odds_2p8_vs_median: median resonance-vs-QCD log-odds on QCD jets more than 2.8 from the median of the run's epochs 70-79, either way
rules.qcd_log_odds_2p8_vs_most_accurate_epoch: median resonance-vs-QCD log-odds on QCD jets more than 2.8 from its value at the most accurate of the run's epochs 70-79, either way

class_mix.description: whether the QCD share of an epoch's training stream tracks that epoch's output layer: Pearson r over epochs 70-79, pooled over runs after z-scoring each run's epochs; p from permuting epochs within runs
